Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation for Finexa - next steps

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your security team what they need: 

- Recap: Finexa is evaluating Redwood for inference on customer PII (user profiles) and some enrichment features. You asked about SOC 2 status, GDPR data residency, HIPAA coverage, and whether we can complete a vendor security questionnaire (SIG or your custom Word doc).

- Current status: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type I (Nov 2025) and is targeting SOC 2 Type II by Q3 2026. We can provide current evidence and our roadmap for Type II.

- Immediate ask: Would you like us to start with the SIG/Standardized Questionnaire (we attach a short intro) or prefer you send the Finexa vendor questionnaire? Either works — we typically return a completed SIG within ~10 business days for straightforward requests.

- Clarifying questions for your security team (please confirm):
  - Which Finexa systems will send data to Redwood (API names/services)?
  - Will any of the data be PHI/clinical in scope (HIPAA)?
  - Required data residency (US, EU, both)?
  - Expected retention windows and deletion requirements?
  - Do you require a BAA or any custom contract clauses?

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_intro_v1.pdf (short intro + what we typically provide)

Next steps I propose:
1) If you want, send the Finexa questionnaire and we'll start on that immediately.
2) Otherwise, confirm SIG and we'll upload our answers to a shared Drive folder and loop in Rishi (security lead).
3) If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min joint call between Finexa security and Redwood security next week.

Looping in Rishi (security) and Marissa (CS/AM) to coordinate.

Thanks,

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the details. A few answers & next steps from security: 

- HIPAA: For teams processing PHI, Redwood can sign a BAA and has a set of controls we apply for covered workloads. Since you indicated no PHI for this pilot, a BAA is not required at this stage.
- SOC 2: We completed Type I in Nov 2025; Type II is targeted for Sep 2026. We can provide the Type I report and our controls matrix today and will share Type II evidence once available.
- Encryption & access: Data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.3. Role-based access controls (RBAC), audit logs, and service account separation are standard.
- SSO & Auth: We support SAML and OIDC (Okta, Azure AD) for dedicated/private deployments; Hosted API supports API keys and can be integrated with customer's SSO for console access.
- Data residency: Hosted accounts default to region selections; we offer region locking for Dedicated/Private deployments for US/EU.
- Turnaround: For a standard SIG filled by our security team we target ~10 business days after we receive the completed questionnaire and any clarifications. Complex custom asks may take longer.

Action items for Finexa that will speed things up:
  1) Send the completed Finexa questionnaire (we can fill it directly).
  2) Confirm retention windows and any deletion/ERASURE SLA requirements.
  3) Flag any specific regulatory requirements (PCI/HIPAA/GDPR) beyond what you've shared.

Link to upload area / evidence: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodSIG
Attach: SIG_template.xlsx (our preferred questionnaire template for faster turnaround)

Happy to jump on a short call with your security team this week if you want to review the plan.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
